train_agent: train the StreetLearn IMPALA agent on specified levels with configurable loss and environment settings
test_agent: test the trained StreetLearn agent across specified levels and report mean episode returns
create_environment: create a StreetLearn environment with configurable observations, graph settings, and curriculum parameters
create_agent: create a city navigation or goal navigation agent with specified action count and observation types
build_actor: build an actor loop that unrolls agent-environment interactions and returns trajectory outputs
